language_task: Stack the yellow triangle on top of the purple cube.
outcome_evidence: The robot acquires and lifts the yellow triangle (frames 75–98, left_base_cam and right_base_cam), then lowers it onto the purple cube and releases it (frames 148–166). After the gripper withdraws, the yellow triangle remains supported above the purple cube (frames 174–200, left_base_cam and right_base_cam, with wrist_cam providing a closer view). The stack remains in place through frame 240; no failed acquisition, collapse, or unintended displacement of the green block is visible.
